program.description: Powertrain trade for a light tactical vehicle of the JLTV class, over the cited model demo/ltv.sysml: the fielded diesel against the eJLTV hybrid. Hybrid figures are the model's (source keys in its header); the diesel is the baseline they are measured from, so its gains are 0. Requirement attributes are 1 where the model records `satisfy <requirement> by trade.<option>`. Weights are an analyst's example.

metrics.description: fuel economy gain over the fielded diesel that holds on the duty cycle (O2)
R5 export power and R6 silent drive and watch, satisfied
R1 payload and R2 reliability, satisfied

assumptions.description: The share of the hybrid's >20% fuel economy gain (O2, a company figure, not an Army test) that holds on the Army duty cycle. Confidence is the analyst's.

bias.check: Was the fielded diesel treated as the answer before the options were measured?

evidence.description: O2, the source of the fuel economy figure
each option's status in the model, keyed by option: its definition's doc and the concerns that threaten it

question.instructions: Is this powertrain fielded and in production, rather than a demonstrator?

nodes.prompt: Summarize the trade for a decision brief. Cite the source key for every figure; add no figure the model does not hold.

question.instructions: Does the brief treat the fielded diesel as the answer before weighing the options?

content.claim: fuel economy improved by more than 20%

content.diesel: LTV::Diesel: Fielded JLTV powertrain: Gale Banks Engineering 866T V8 turbodiesel, based on the GM Duramax L5P, and an Allison 2500SP automatic (W1).
content.hybrid: LTV::Hybrid (since 2022-01-25, O2): Diesel-electric hybrid eJLTV. LTV::maturity: The eJLTV was a demonstrator with no orders when unveiled (B1).

bias.check: Was the fielded diesel treated as the answer before the options were measured?

brief.output: Diesel: the fielded powertrain, 400 hp and 850 lb-ft (W1); it meets payload (O1) and the 2,400 MMBOMF reliability target (W2). Hybrid: fuel economy better by more than 20% (O2, a company figure), 30 minutes of silent drive (B1), up to 115 kW export power (O2), and more than 1,000 lb of added curb weight (J1); a demonstrator with no orders when unveiled (B1). The Army ended JLTV procurement after its January 2025 tranche (C2).

output.note: Hold: the fuel gain is a company figure (O2); ask for duty-cycle data.

approve.note: Hold: the fuel gain is a company figure (O2); ask for duty-cycle data.
